Recorded claim:
The import result carries all affected fingerprints; keyRing joins them into one localized warning after cache clear and opens a Help page if the user chooses Help. D200823 changed the copy to describe a real compatibility consequence rather than repeat technical flag names or explain the obvious Help button. It removed en-US from the support URL so the site can select locale. The article opens externally because a modal import wizard would hide a content tab behind it. Current keyRing.sys.mjs retains this behavior.
